parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables and disables the CPE's user interface.

parameters.name: PasswordRequired
parameters.description: Present only if the CPE provides a password-protected LAN-side user interface. Indicates whether or not the local user interface MUST require a password to be chosen by the user. If {{false}}, the choice of whether or not a password is used is left to the user.

parameters.name: PasswordUserSelectable
parameters.description: Present only if the CPE provides a password-protected LAN-side user interface and supports LAN-side Auto-Configuration. Indicates whether or not a password to protect the local user interface of the CPE MAY be selected by the user directly (i.e. {{param|#.Users.User.{i}.Password}}), or MUST be equal to the password used by the LAN-side Auto-Configuration protocol (i.e. {{param|#.LANConfigSecurity.ConfigPassword}}).

parameters.name: UpgradeAvailable
parameters.description: Indicates that a CPE upgrade is available, allowing the CPE to display this information to the user.

parameters.name: WarrantyDate
parameters.description: Indicates the date and time in UTC that the warranty associated with the CPE is to expire.

parameters.name: ISPName
parameters.description: The name of the customer's ISP.

parameters.name: ISPHelpDesk
parameters.description: The help desk phone number of the ISP.

parameters.name: ISPHomePage
parameters.description: The {{datatype}} of the ISP's home page.

parameters.name: ISPHelpPage
parameters.description: The {{datatype}} of the ISP's on-line support page.

parameters.name: ISPLogo
parameters.description: Base64 encoded GIF or JPEG image. The binary image is constrained to 4095 bytes or less.

parameters.name: ISPLogoSize
parameters.description: Un-encoded binary image size in bytes. If ISPLogoSize input value is 0 then the ISPLogo is cleared. ISPLogoSize can also be used as a check to verify correct transfer and conversion of Base64 string to image size.

parameters.name: ISPMailServer
parameters.description: The {{datatype}} of the ISP's mail server.

parameters.name: ISPNewsServer
parameters.description: The {{datatype}} of the ISP's news server.

parameters.name: TextColor
parameters.description: The color of text on the GUI screens in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: BackgroundColor
parameters.description: The color of the GUI screen backgrounds in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: ButtonColor
parameters.description: The color of buttons on the GUI screens in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: ButtonTextColor
parameters.description: The color of text on buttons on the GUI screens in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: AutoUpdateServer
parameters.description: The server the CPE can check to see if an update is available for direct download to it.

parameters.name: UserUpdateServer
parameters.description: The server where a user can check via a web browser if an update is available for download to a PC.

parameters.name: AvailableLanguages
parameters.description: {{list}} List items represent user-interface languages that are available, where each language is specified according to {{bibref|RFC3066}}.

parameters.name: CurrentLanguage
parameters.description: Current user-interface language, specified according to {{bibref|RFC3066}}. The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the {{param|AvailableLanguages}} parameter.

parameters.name: HTTPAccessSupportedProtocols
parameters.description: Indicates the protocols that are supported by the CPE for the purpose of remotely accessing the user interface.

parameters.name: HTTPAccessNumberOfEntries
parameters.description: {{numentries}}

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to the user interface of the CPE.
